items.question: Which practice is designated as breath control by experts in yoga scripture?
premises: Experts in yoga scripture possess authoritative knowledge of yogic practices.
These experts designate this specific practice as prāṇāyāma.
Prāṇāyāma is defined as the extension or control of breath.
items.inference: The practice referred to is identified as prāṇāyāma by experts in yoga scripture.
uncertainties: The referent of imaṃ depends on the preceding verse or context not included here.
items.plain_english: Experts in the yoga scriptures call this breath control (prāṇāyāma).
